metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant log record has an explicit record identity or stable sequence identity within a declared log stream.
semantics.execution_rule: Operation/run/step/request refs are included when available.
semantics.time_rule: Occurrence timestamp is evidence metadata, not authority/identity.
semantics.message_rule: Log text is descriptive evidence and not canonical semantic state.
semantics.authority_rule: Log presence never grants action authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: log text treated as canonical state

references.purpose: Errors may produce linked log evidence.
